description: Defines data transfer objects (DTOs) for calendar events and a validation utility within the CalendarBackend API.

classes.name: EventDto
classes.description: DTO representing a calendar event with properties like Id, Title, Description, timing, location, and color.

classes.name: CreateEventRequest
classes.description: DTO used to request creation of a new event, including optional Description, Location, and Color fields.

classes.name: UpdateEventRequest
classes.description: DTO used to request an update to an existing event, including optional fields.

classes.name: EventValidation
classes.description: Contains static methods for validating event data, such as title presence and time logic.

methods.name: EventValidation.Validate
methods.description: Validates event title and start/end times, ensuring title is not empty and end time is after start time.
